hypotheses.title: Batch 85: Orthogonal Techniques Sprint (Targeting Alpha 28 & Uniqueness Recovery)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly expands technique and domain diversification away from accounting fundamentals into three mathematically distinct quantitative paradigms: (1) Candidate 1: Trend Efficiency Ratio (ratio of net directional progress to total traversed path length in pv1). (2) Candidate 2: Abnormal Volume Absorption and Intraday Range Exhaustion Reversion in pv1. (3) Candidate 3: Intra-Industry Low-Beta / Betting-Against-Beta Quality Anomaly in model51. None of these use signed_power or linear polynomial scaffolds, guaranteeing complete decorrelation from recent fundamental alphas.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if trend efficiency, volume absorption reversion, or low-beta factor premia fail to achieve Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50 under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Trend Efficiency Ratio): Implements Perry Kaufman's market efficiency ratio, measuring directional displacement divided by cumulative absolute path distance over 20 days. Isolates persistent, low-noise institutional trends. Zero accounting data, pure topological momentum.

Candidate 2 (Abnormal Volume Absorption Reversion): Statistical arbitrage model fading extreme intraday range pushes accompanied by abnormal volume surges (volume / adv20). Exploits liquidity exhaustion and dealer inventory rebalancing.

Candidate 3 (Intra-Industry Low-Beta Anomaly): Classical empirical asset pricing anomaly (Frazzini-Pedersen Betting Against Beta). Long low-beta and short high-beta equities within each subindustry, capturing the leverage-constraint risk premium from model51.
